questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate the English cue 'on the left at the third corner' into Japanese using the pattern 'Depaato wa ___ ni arimasu'.

answers.answer_text: Depaato wa mittsu-me no kado no hidari ni arimasu.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate the English cue 'on the right at the next intersection' into Japanese using the pattern 'Depaato wa ___ ni arimasu'.

answers.answer_text: Depaato wa tsugi no koosaten no migi ni arimasu.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate the English cue 'beyond the second traffic light' into Japanese using the pattern 'Depaato wa ___ ni arimasu'.

answers.answer_text: Depaato wa futatsu-me no shingoo no saki ni arimasu.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate the English cue 'to the right at the next corner' into Japanese using the pattern 'Depaato wa ___ ni arimasu'.

answers.answer_text: Depaato wa tsugi no kado no migi ni arimasu.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate the English cue 'to the left at the second traffic light' into Japanese using the pattern 'Depaato wa ___ ni arimasu'.

answers.answer_text: Depaato wa futatsu-me no shingoo no hidari ni arimasu.
